Implementation.criterion_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation
Implementation.source_section: 3. Quality and efficiency of the implementation

compliance_checklist.description: Scope of the application: the proposal must correspond, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it was submitted; partial out-of-scope must be reflected in scoring.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): declaration of whether the proposal involves hESC use and, if so, whether it is necessary to achieve the scientific objectives.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: declaration of whether the proposal involves the use of human embryos and, if so, how they will be used.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: the proposal must not include human reproductive cloning, heritable genetic modification (except gonad cancer treatment research), creation of human embryos solely for research/stem-cell procurement, or destruction of human embryos.
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: proposed activities must have an exclusive focus on civil applications (military application or purposes cannot be funded).
compliance_checklist.source_section: 2. Other Questions — Exclusive focus on civil applications

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding: third-country participants/international organisations not listed in the General Annex may only receive funding exceptionally where participation is essential; applicable participants and reasons must be identified.
Overall scoring threshold: the sum of the three individually weighted criterion scores must meet the overall threshold of 70/100; each criterion scored 0-5 at one-decimal resolution.
compliance_checklist.source_section: IMPORTANT NOTICE — Thresholds & weighting; Total score / Overall threshold /100
